founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Colombian 🇨🇴
Ex cofounder @ Wabi.

A born entrepreneur and a firm believer in the builder mindset, I went through Y Combinator (S21) and Rockstart Latam, and that experience shapes everything about how I sell.
 
Today I close enterprise AI and SaaS deals across Latin America. I've led commercial expansion across several LATAM markets in FSI, insurance, retail, and other industries — generating ~$2M in contracted ARR.
 
I understand heavyweight technical ecosystems — ERPs, Core Banking, WMS, C
